page.overview:
Who is Crocodile with Party Hat?

is one of the audience members in the episode "Wizard Battle." She is sitting next to Peppermint Butler. She was wearing the party hat because she was waiting for someone to say "happy birthday" to her.

As the name states, she is just an ordinary crocodile with a blue and orange-striped party hat.
